refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: systemd-timestampd is a system service that acquires RFC 3161 time-stamp tokens from a Time-Stamp Authority (TSA) on behalf of clients, via a Varlink IPC API. A client supplies a message digest, and then the service creates a time-stamp request, sends it to the configured authority, waits for the reply, and returns the resulting time-stamp token.

Both the HTTP(S) and TCP transports described in RFC 3161 are supported; the transport is selected by the scheme of the authority URL (http://, https:// or tcp://). The HTTP(S) transport requires that this build has libcurl support; without it only tcp:// authorities are accepted. The authority is configured in timestampd.conf5, and may be overridden per request.

This service provides one Varlink service: io.systemd.Timestamp, which exposes a single Request method. The method accepts a hex-encoded digest and its hash algorithm and, once the authority responds, returns the PEM-encoded time-stamp token with a PKCS7 label. The returned token is a PKCS#7 SignedData structure exactly as issued by the authority. The verification is left to the caller, or relying party that consumes the token.
